title: Armour Stripping
description: Remove the Netherite from your gear! Save your items or recycle the Ingots for another tool.
body:
Tired of wasting Netherite on a Chestplate with mid enchants only to just stumble across a better one later? Strip the Netherite from your Diamond Tools with a Blast Furnace!

Putting any Netherite type item into a Blast Furnace will remove the Netherite as a single ingot output and leave behind your Diamond gear with all its stats intact from trim to enchants!
